result.summary: The main issue is the overlapping UI elements in the bottom navigation bar and the footer, caused by a lack of proper safe area padding or layout clipping.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar and the content (specifically the pizza item card) overlap with the home indicator area of the device, causing visual clutter and potential touch issues.
issues.suggestion: Implement system safe area insets at the bottom of the screen to ensure the bottom navigation bar is not obscured by or overlapping with the device's home indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation items (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) appear to be slightly cut off or lack sufficient padding at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding of the navigation bar container to ensure all icons and labels are fully visible above the system interface.
